info.title: Multi-Tenant Recharge SaaS
info.description: Tenant routes require verified hostname. On configured shared API hosts use verified Origin or X-Tenant-Domain selector; tokens remain bound to tenant. Platform routes require platform host and Developer credentials. Money is INR paise. Percentages are basis points. MOCK payment adapter only; real recharge and BBPS integrations require documented providers and credentials.

servers.description: Tenant host for tenant routes; platform host for platform routes
